{{Top|ca|leg}}
'''Xenoarborists''' were specialists that studied [[Tree/Legends|trees]]. During the last [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]],<ref name="SWJA">{{JournalCite|6|The Greel Wood Haven}}</ref> which [[Declaration of a New Order|dissolved]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> xenoarborists were consulted by the entrepreneur [[Meysen Kayson]] after he discovered a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[greel tree]] on [[Pii III]] and [[Pii IV]], the third and fourth [[Planet/Legends|planets]], respectively, in the [[Pii system/Legends|Pii system]], which led to the discovery of the [[Plant/Legends|tree's]] rapid growth rate.<ref name="SWJA" /> By [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> xenoarborists theorized that decades beforehand the [[senoti]] tree, [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the planet [[New Canistel]] in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]], was introduced to the [[Forest/Legends|forest]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] by one of two [[Canistel AgriStar]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] lost in the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]].<ref name="SWG">{{GamerCite|9|Endor and the Moddell Sector}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Xenoarborists were first mentioned in "[[The Greel Wood Haven]]," a ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' source article written by [[Craig Robert Carey|C. Robert Carey]] and published in the [[May]] [[1995]] [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 6|sixth issue]] of [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' magazine.<ref name="SWJA" /> The word "xenoarborist" is a combination of the prefix "xeno-," meaning alien,<ref name="Xeno">{{WebCite|url=https://www.dictionary.com/browse/xeno-|text=XENO- Definition & Meaning|work=[[Wikipedia:Dictionary.com|Dictionary.com, LLC]]|quote=a combining form meaning "alien," "strange," "guest," used in the formation of compound words|archivedate=20220629044904}}</ref> and "[[Wikipedia:Arborist|arborist]]," denoting a specialist in the cultivation and care of trees.<ref name="Graphology">{{WebCite|url=https://www.dictionary.com/browse/arborist|text=ARBORIST Definition & Meaning|work=[[Wikipedia:Dictionary.com|Dictionary.com, LLC]]|quote=1. a specialist in the cultivation and care of trees and shrubs, including tree surgery, the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of tree diseases, and the control of pests.|archivedate=20240721102835}}</ref>
